text: stablished as follows： when gefitinib was combined with acid-suppressing drugs， it should be subject to “manual review”；when gefitinib was combined with dexamethasone， metoprolol， or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors， an “alert” should be triggered， and the physician should be informed via an alert box to strengthen the monitoring of relevant indicators. Clinical pharmacists need to conduct in-depth training on knowledge related to gefitinib drug interactions in key clinical departments such as respiratory medicine. They should strengthen the monitoring and guidance of rational drug use for patients who are on long-term gefitinib therapy， and promptly identify and intervene in PK-pADIs， thereby enhancing the rationality， safety， and effectiveness of clinical drug use.KEYWORDS gefitinib；potential adverse drug interactions based on pharmacokinetics；prescription analysis；
